content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Does anyone know how to implement value comparisons (greater than, less than, or equal to) in a PLC? Looking forward to your responses! Best regards, [user_name]

Hi, You can use an analog comparator block for this purpose. By configuring two comparators with inverted inputs (A,B and B,A) and setting the threshold to zero: - When A > B, the first output is activated - When A < B, the second output is activated - When A = B, both outputs remain off Hope this helps!
Hello, Thanks for your assistance. I'll test this approach right away.
